items.title: Business Law
items.description: Strategic legal solutions to help businesses start, grow, and succeed with confidence.
items.overviewTitle: Strategic Legal Support for Every Stage of Your Business
items.overviewText:
At Verdicta, we are committed to delivering exceptional legal services with integrity, dedication, and a commitment to achieving the best possible outcomes for our clients with a client-first approach — ensuring personalized strategies, clear communication, and strong advocacy from start to finish.

Whether you are facing a complex legal dispute, seeking business counsel, or protecting your personal rights, we stand ready to guide you through every step of the process. With a proven track record and a passion for justice, we are here to protect what matters most to you.

areasCovered.title: Business Formation
areasCovered.text: Choose the right structure and set a solid legal foundation.

areasCovered.title: Contracts & Agreements
areasCovered.text: Clear, enforceable contracts that protect your interests.

areasCovered.title: Compliance & Regulations
areasCovered.text: Stay compliant with evolving laws and industry regulations.

areasCovered.title: Dispute Resolution
areasCovered.text: Resolve disputes efficiently and protect your business.

areasCovered.title: Mergers & Acquisitions
areasCovered.text: Guidance through complex transactions and negotiations.

areasCovered.title: Ongoing Legal Counsel
areasCovered.text: Reliable legal support for day-to-day business needs.

contactBanner.title: Need Legal Assistance for Your Business?
contactBanner.description: Let our experienced attorneys help you navigate legal challenges and achieve your business goals.

items.title: Family Law
items.description: Compassionate representation for divorce, custody, support, and other family matters.
items.overviewTitle: Compassionate Legal Support for Your Family
items.overviewText:
Family law matters require both legal expertise and sensitivity. We provide compassionate representation and guidance to help you navigate challenging times, prioritizing the well-being of you and your loved ones.

From complex divorces to child custody disputes, we offer strategic solutions tailored to your unique family dynamics.

areasCovered.title: Divorce Proceedings
areasCovered.text: Navigate divorce with experienced legal guidance.

areasCovered.title: Child Custody
areasCovered.text: Protect your parental rights and child's best interests.

contactBanner.title: Facing a Family Legal Issue?
contactBanner.description: Our compassionate attorneys are here to support and guide you.

items.title: Insurance Defense
items.description: Strong defense for insurance claims and litigation to protect your interests.
items.overviewText:
We provide robust defense strategies for insurance claims and litigation, safeguarding your interests and minimizing exposure.

Our team has a proven track record of successfully resolving complex claims through negotiation and trial.

areasCovered.title: Litigation Defense
areasCovered.text: Strong defense in court against complex claims.

contactBanner.title: Need Insurance Defense?
contactBanner.description: Protect your interests with our experienced litigators.

items.title: Criminal Law
items.description: Aggressive defense and experienced advocacy to protect your rights and freedom.
items.overviewText:
If you are facing criminal charges, you need a relentless advocate in your corner. We offer aggressive defense and experienced advocacy to protect your rights, freedom, and future.

We handle all types of cases, from misdemeanors to complex felonies.

areasCovered.title: White Collar Crimes
areasCovered.text: Defense against fraud and financial charges.

contactBanner.title: Facing Criminal Charges?
contactBanner.description: Don't face them alone. Get experienced defense today.

items.title: Real Estate Law
items.description: Guidance for property transactions, leases, disputes, and all real estate legal matters.
items.overviewText:
Whether you are buying, selling, or leasing property, we offer comprehensive guidance to ensure smooth transactions and protect your investments.

We also handle complex real estate disputes and litigation.

areasCovered.title: Commercial Real Estate
areasCovered.text: Legal support for commercial property transactions.

areasCovered.title: Property Disputes
areasCovered.text: Resolution of property and boundary disputes.

contactBanner.title: Real Estate Legal Needs?
contactBanner.description: Secure your investments with our expert counsel.

items.title: Estate Planning
items.description: Plan for the future and protect your assets with wills, trusts, and estate planning.
items.overviewTitle: Secure Your Legacy and Protect Your Assets
items.overviewText:
Proper estate planning ensures your wishes are honored and your loved ones are provided for. We help you create wills, trusts, and comprehensive plans to protect your legacy.

Don't leave your future to chance. Let us help you plan with confidence.

areasCovered.title: Wills & Trusts
areasCovered.text: Create robust wills and trusts for your family.

items.title: New Companies Act Amendments 2024: Key Changes and Compliance Impact
items.excerpt: The latest amendments bring significant changes to corporate governance, compliance requirements, and reporting obligations. Here's what businesses need to know.

contentBlocks.text: The Companies (Amendment) Act, 2024, introduces a series of reforms aimed at enhancing ease of doing business, strengthening corporate governance, and ensuring greater transparency. These changes will impact companies of all sizes and require timely action to ensure compliance.

contentBlocks.heading: Enhanced Disclosure Requirements
contentBlocks.text: Companies must now provide more detailed disclosures in their board reports, including ESG (Environmental, Social, and Governance) metrics and risk management policies.

contentBlocks.heading: Changes in Board Composition
contentBlocks.text: The amendment introduces stricter criteria for independent directors and mandates diversity in board composition for certain classes of companies.

contentBlocks.heading: Stricter Compliance and Penalties
contentBlocks.text: Non-compliance will attract higher penalties and stricter enforcement, with a focus on promoting accountability among key managerial personnel.

contentBlocks.heading: Simplified Annual Filing Process
contentBlocks.text: The amendment streamlines annual filing and reduces compliance burden through integrated forms and digital reporting mechanisms.

contentBlocks.heading: Strengthened Shareholder Rights
contentBlocks.text: Shareholders will now have greater rights in approving related party transactions and major corporate actions.

contentBlocks.heading: What This Means for Your Business

contentBlocks.text: These amendments are designed to promote responsible business practices and improve investor confidence. Companies should review their internal policies, governance structures, and compliance frameworks to align with the new requirements.

items.title: Associate Attorney
items.aboutRole: We are seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Associate Attorney to join our dynamic legal team. The successful candidate will work on a variety of matters including corporate transactions, contracts, due diligence, and legal research. You'll collaborate with senior attorneys and clients to deliver practical, strategic, and high-quality legal solutions.
responsibilities: Draft, review, and negotiate contracts and legal documents.
Conduct legal research and analysis on a wide range of issues.
Assist in corporate transactions, due diligence, and regulatory compliance.
Prepare legal opinions, memoranda, and other written materials.
Work closely with clients and internal teams to understand legal needs and provide solution-oriented advice.
Manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
requirements: Juris Doctor (JD) degree from an accredited law school.
2 - 5 years of experience in corporate or transactional law.
Strong analytical, research, and drafting skills.
Excellent communication and interpersonal abilities.
Admission to the New York State Bar (required).
Proficiency in MS Office and legal research tools.
preferredQualifications: Experience in mergers & acquisitions or corporate law is a plus.
Prior experience in a law firm environment.
